Title: Power of One and limited keyword

Messages.Author: ResurrectioN
Messages.Body:
Text on  for Power of One is similar to text on  on Revelation of Serpent with one small difference.

In Power of One limited keyword is missing after "+ 1 bleed" which might imply that it is not limited if the card is played only for + 1 bleed but is limited if card is played for "+1 bleed and +1 stealth". Compare to the wording on Revelation of Serpent where limited is after both options.

Maybe it's an inconsistency maybe PoO is better than initially perceived

Relevant cards

Messages.Author: Yomyael
Messages.Body:
Indeed, the templating is different. They work the same however, since (limited) is just a reminder. To work differently, explicit text "that does not count against the limit" is needed, like on Power of One at potence.

Messages.Author: Bloodartist
Messages.Body:
> ResurrectioN wrote:
> Maybe it's an inconsistency maybe PoO is better than initially perceived
>
There is no inconsistency, since bleed modifiers are limited by default. The text in brackets is just a reminder of this. Now bleed modifiers have to explicitly state if they are not limited.

This is an official rules change from before when it used to be the other way around, so oldtimer players may get confused by this.
